notes: Source is the Mistral Docs model page (https://docs.mistral.ai/models/model-cards/devstral-small-2-25-12). It is a product/model catalog page (release date, context, license, params, features), not a safety system card: no risk tiers, no safety topics, no numeric eval tables on this page. Text was taken from the page HTML/RSC (curl + Next.js RSC payload); headless Chrome could not resolve DNS in this environment. Weights table: Parameters (B) 24, Active (B) 24, Context Size 256k, License Apache 2.0. Modalities from tooltip labels: Text input, Image input, Text output. The Blog link points to https://mistral.ai/news/devstral-2-vibe-cli (SWE-bench Verified 68.0% for Devstral Small 2, etc.); that URL is seeded under mistral-devstral-2-system-card, not this key, so those eval numbers were not included.
